description: Get a container by id: current status, terminal holds, demurrage last free day (LFD / pickup_lfd), availability for pickup, and key milestone timestamps. Set include_events=true to also fetch normalized transport events (vessel/rail moves). Example: terminal49_container({ id: "8a1f...", include_events: true, _apiKey: "your-key" })

include_events.description: If true, include transport_events (normalized vessel/rail milestones) in the response.
